text.title: 开门处的一只蜜蜂
text.situation:
门开向一畦刚开始开花的植物。蜜蜂落在花上，在来访的花之间携带花粉。露丝解释蜜蜂如何授粉。门边展台有一只六条腿、翅膀受损的昆虫，是保存标本，不是外面的蜜蜂。旁边是蜂巢群体照片和一个巢室内幼虫的特写。玛雅退开，让活蜜蜂飞出去。

玛雅：要关门吗？
露丝：先留空间让蜜蜂出去。
乔：这条幼虫已是成虫吗？
露丝：不是。照片展示生命中较早阶段。
她们等蜜蜂从花上飞起。

paragraphs.en: The door stood open to a bed of plants beginning to blossom. A bee landed on a flower, carrying pollen between the flowers it visited. Ruth explained how bees can pollinate flowers. A display by the door showed an insect with six legs and a damaged wing; it was a preserved specimen, not the bee outside. Next to it was a photograph of a colony inside a hive, with a close-up of a larva in one cell. Maya stepped back so the living bee could leave.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Shall I shut the door?
Ruth: Give the bee room to go out first.
Jo: Is this larva already an adult insect?
Ruth: No. The photograph shows an earlier stage of its life.
They waited until the bee lifted from the flower.

S15.G06.P01.function: A bee at the open door
S15.G06.P01.cue: 描述植物和蜜蜂正在做什么。
acceptableAnswers: 植物开始开花，蜜蜂正在采花粉。

S15.G06.P02.function: A bee at the open door
S15.G06.P02.cue: 解释蜜蜂的作用和标本特征。
acceptableAnswers: 蜜蜂为花授粉。昆虫标本有一只受损翅膀。

S15.G06.P03.cue: 描述蜂巢照片中的群体和幼体。
acceptableAnswers: 照片展示群体和巢室内一条幼虫。

S15.G06.T01.function: A bee at the open door
S15.G06.T01.cue: 蜜蜂进入教室，描述它并请人让开。
acceptableAnswers: 窗边有一只蜜蜂，请让它有空间飞出去。
